snippet.title: Esports Manager 2026 | Release Announcement Date Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Build your roster. Shape your legacy. 
Esports Manager 2026 launches on Steam July 6th, 2026.

Wishlist and play the demo now ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2749950/Esports_Manager_2026/

Take control of an esports organization and guide it from underdog contender to global powerhouse. Scout rising talent, manage team dynamics, negotiate contracts, and outmaneuver the competition in the most ambitious entry in the series yet.

🎮 Build championship-winning rosters across multiple esports titles
📈 Develop players, strategies, and team chemistry
💰 Manage finances, sponsors, contracts, and facilities
🏆 Compete in prestigious tournaments around the world
⚡ Make the tough decisions that define an esports dynasty

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q

#EsportsManager2026 #Esports #ManagementGame  #SimulationGame #SportsManagement #StrategyGame #IndieGames
